title: systemform
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): ancestorformid, organizationid.

canbedeleted.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be deleted.

description.description: Description of the form or dashboard.

formactivationstate.description: Specifies the state of the form.

formid.description: Unique identifier of the record type form.

formidunique.description: Unique identifier of the form used when synchronizing customizations for the Microsoft Dynamics 365 client for Outlook.

formjson.description: Json representation of the form layout.

formpresentation.description: Specifies whether this form is in the updated UI layout in Microsoft Dynamics CRM 2015 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM Online 2015 Update.

formxml.description: XML representation of the form layout.

formxmlmanaged.description: formXml diff as in a managed solution.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the form is introduced.

isairmerged.description: Specifies whether this form is merged with the updated UI layout in Microsoft Dynamics CRM 2015 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM Online 2015 Updat…

iscustomizable.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be customized.

isdefault.description: Information that specifies whether the form or the dashboard is the system default.

isdesktopenabled.description: Information that specifies whether the dashboard is enabled for desktop.

istabletenabled.description: Information that specifies whether the dashboard is enabled for tablet.

objecttypecode.description: Code that represents the record type.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

type.description: Type of the form, for example, Dashboard or Preview.

versionnumber.description: Represents a version of customizations to be synchronized with the Microsoft Dynamics 365 client for Outlook.

_ancestorformid_value.description: Unique identifier of the parent form.
